purpose: Bind the scheduled citywide address-index refresh to every committed derived artifact that declares the refreshed geography inputs and is re-checked with a --check drift gate. The rebuild sequence runs after the PAD snapshot, in dependency order, and published_paths is the only list the workflow may stage.

additional_required_builders.reason: Corpus backtest coverage hashes site/data/shared_meeting_read_model.json. Address-geography refresh restamps that resident meeting document, so the committed corpus_backtest and corpus_coverage fixtures must rebuild in the same change.

published_paths.reason: Official PAD snapshot shards and manifest produced by the address-index builder.
Meeting-geography generation activated by the address-geography refresh.
Resident meeting read model restamped when meeting-geography memberships change.
Parcel-point and membership shards recomputed when PAD content or boundaries change.
Active Land project-lot geography membership index invalidated when parcel memberships change.
Per-project Land place evidence shards that travel with the active membership index.
Immutable Land place generation tree, ACTIVE pointer, and refresh receipt published with the membership rebuild.
Procurement intent corpus backtest and coverage receipts restated from the refreshed shared meeting read model.
Human-readable corpus backtest report rewritten beside the measured JSON fixtures.

rebuild_sequence.note: Parcel membership changes invalidate Land project-lot joins. The refresh publishes one coherent generation and mirrors it into the active membership index and evidence shards that build_land_place_membership.mjs --check re-derives. When address-geography rewrites parcel manifests without moving the Land place generation aggregate, hermetic bootstrap can leave active mirrors stale; post_verify then force-republishes.
Shared meeting read-model restamps invalidate the committed procurement-intent corpus backtest and coverage receipts that site-node lockstep tests re-derive.
